title: Dietary Modulation of microRNAs as a Potential Nutritional Strategy in Inflammatory and Autoimmune Skin Diseases: A Narrative Review.
snippet: Inflammatory and autoimmune skin diseases like psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, and hidradenitis suppurativa present significant therapeutic challenges due to their complex immunological and environmental pathogenesis.
